verdict.rationale: Subnet routing (reaching an entire remote subnet via a single gateway node, à la Tailscale subnet routers) is a mesh-VPN networking feature, not something an SSH/terminal client like Termius provides. Termius offers per-host jump hosts, port forwarding, and tunneling, but these require configuring access per host/service, not exposing a whole subnet transparently — this capability class is outside Termius's product category.
